arenas._comment_dressing: Roadside practice ground: open grass, dressing outside the 12x8 grid per the standing rule. Enemy spawns are Chebyshev 5 from the player spawn ON PURPOSE: 3 free steps exhaust the pool short of contact (beat 3), Dash covers the rest with AP to spare for one attack -- the full teaching arc fits in turn 1.

tutor_lines.line: Relc: Loose grip, dead stance. We'll fix both. Arrows move you. Three easy steps a turn, so use your legs before anything fancy.
Relc: That's walking. Now get next to one and press 1. That's your arm. Numbers are your moves, remember them.
Relc: Steps run out, see? Slot 2: [Dash]. Costs you wind, buys you stride.
Relc: And the legs are back. Wind for stride. That trade wins fights.
Relc: Tab swaps targets, Enter commits. A spear only argues with one thing at a time.
Relc: Ha! Straw everywhere. When you're spent, press E. End your turn on YOUR terms.
Relc: Turn's done. Now stand there and watch what comes back at you. That's half of fighting.
Relc: Not bad for someone who smells of dish soap. Sleep is where a fight settles into your bones. Do that. Then come see me; I owe you something.

arenas._comment: Onboarding O3: layout-identical clone of goblin_ambush carrying the PART-2 tutor beats (arenas own tutor_lines and goblin_ambush is shared with goblin_encounter_2, which must stay beat-free). goblin_encounter_1 points here. Task 7c (No Killing Goblins seed, Part 2): road_clear's line grew a second sentence (Relc's sign acknowledgment, verbatim seed copy 3) -- placement trace: no shipped QA script pins `road_clear`'s exact `line` text (every reference is `payload_contains: {beat: "road_clear"}`, grepped across every qa/scripts/*.json), and `combat_hud.gd`'s `match_tutor_line` fires at most ONE tutor entry per incoming event (`ready[0]`), so a second tutor_lines entry on the SAME combat_finished/victory trigger could never fire -- appending to this existing line is the only way to land the beat here at all, and it moves ZERO pins. Thematically it is the natural close of the road-fight ("teeth are teeth out here" pairs directly with the ambush that just ended), unlike the harmless training-yard spar. The feed panel auto-grows for tutor lines (`_grow_feed_panel_for_tutor`, capped/evicts oldest -- see CLAUDE.md's wrapped-line-budget gotcha) and this fires as the LAST beat of the fight, so evicting older combat-log lines here is harmless. Windowed-verified via a throwaway probe (not committed) reading the grown feed panel in full.

tutor_lines.line: Relc: Real ones this time. Stay behind me if you have to. You slept, so check your numbers: 3 and up are your [Skills] now. Earned, not given.
Relc: That one puts everything behind one blow. What your slots hold follows the weapon you carry: sword skills for a sword arm, spear skills for mine.
Relc: THAT'S the stuff. Attacks keep you alive. [Skills] win the fight. Sleep grows both.
Relc: Road's clear. Liscor's through the gate. Tell the Watch that Relc let you pass. See the sign? Her inn, her rule. But under her roof? Don't.

arenas._comment: M-ARC A2: the deep warren -- the Awakened Raskghar's boss arena (12x8 per the M1 arena contract test_combat_data enforces; cave biome, darkest pin lives in data/moods.json arena_moods.deep_warren). Interior `blocked` cells are twin broken pillars (x3/x8) + a central rubble block (x6) that make the fight about POSITIONING: they break the boss's range-2 maul line-of-sight and give the player + Relc lanes to corner the kiting boss against, rather than an open trade. All six blocked cells are kept clear of every player/enemy spawn (test_combat_data asserts spawn reachability + connectivity). The boss ENCOUNTER entity that fields raskghar_awakened + 2 raskghar_scout adds here is A3's climax chain; A2 ships the arena + the gated balance band (sim_combat_batch.gd BOSS_CELLS).
